name: Weekly Retro Action Reminder
description: Every Sunday 9am, email open approved actions from the latest archived retro snapshot via Gmail.

prompts.text:
Follow the weekly-action-reminder skill in this repository.

1. Read docs/reminders/latest-reminder.json. If missing, stop with a clear error: run archive + npm run export:reminder first.
2. Read docs/reminders/recipients.json for to addresses and subjectPrefix.
3. Compose a concise HTML email: sprint title, period, team, archived date, and a bullet list of open approved actions (id, title, owner, target date, short description).
4. Include a one-line themes summary from reportExcerpt.themesSummary when present.
5. Send via Gmail send_message. Subject: {subjectPrefix} Open actions — {title} ({period}).
6. Do not modify repository files, merge PRs, or change action status.
7. Use team/process language only; never deanonymize feedback.
